global.title: Pharmaceutical Executive Daily: FDA Approves Three New Therapies
global.summary: FDA approves three new therapies, a wave of dealmaking led by Johnson & Johnson, Eli Lilly, AmyriAD Therapeutics, and Sanofi, and Ossium Health’s Kevin Caldwell joins The Ron Lanton Report on rebuilding bone marrow transplants around deceased-donor marrow.

global.title: AstraZeneca secures FDA approval for Imfinzi combo in MIBC
global.summary: The US FDA has approved AstraZeneca's Imfinzi in combination with enfortumab vedotin for adult patients with MIBC who cannot receive or have refused cisplatin-based chemotherapy.
